title: 'IPC Interactive Meet on Pharmacopoeia Standards' in Haridwar on October 14, 2023
bodyHtml: IPC and the Association of Devbhumi Pharma Industries (Uttarakhand) organized an 'IPC Interactive Meet on Pharmacopoeia Standards' in Haridwar on October 14, 2023. Chief Guest Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director-IPC and Drugs Controller General (India) inaugurated the Interactive Meet. Mr. Tajber Singh, Drug Controlling and Licensing Authority, Uttarakhand was the Guest of Honour of the Meet. During the meet, technical presentations were made by the DCGI and IPC officials on Drug regulatory landscape in India, Role of IPC in setting standards, Dissolution and microbiological testing, and Revised Schedule M. This meet was attended by the industry representatives of the Uttarakhand region.
